_comment: xstockstrat-agent MCP configuration for Claude.ai / Claude Desktop.
_usage: Paste the relevant block into your Claude Desktop config or Claude.ai MCP settings.

xstockstrat-stdio._mode: stdio -- run locally outside Docker (recommended for Claude Desktop)

xstockstrat-http-oauth._mode: Streamable HTTP remote MCP with OAuth 2.1 (RECOMMENDED for Claude.ai). The url is the agent's public base URL itself, with NO path suffix -- the client POSTs/GETs it directly. It discovers the auth server via /.well-known, performs RFC 7591 DCR + PKCE login, and connects with an aud-bound JWT. No api_key needed.
xstockstrat-http-oauth._migration: Feature 079 removed the legacy HTTP+SSE transport. If a saved connector's url still ends in /sse it now returns 404 -- trim it to the bare base URL below. No re-authorization is needed.
